summary:
P4 wave 2 (AlembicAgent in-process wrapper parity) complete — commit f8ddddd on main (baseline eab6c88; no push/tag/version bump). ADDITIVE TEST ONLY: git status shows ONLY the new test/recipe-authoring-inprocess-parity.test.ts added — the P1.4b wrapper (recipeAuthoringGate.ts), the in-process gate (knowledge.ts), the producer prompt (insightProducer.ts) and the P1.4b suite are byte-unchanged (git diff --stat = empty); gates not relaxed. Consumes AlembicCore 47391c6 (P4 wave 1, gates byte-identical) via @alembic/core/knowledge.

Added the IN-PROCESS side of the §12.5 two-paths-tie parity tripwire: for a fixture corpus (gate-clean + stage-1/2/3 + fs NOT_FOUND/LINE_OUT_OF_RANGE), asserts runInProcessRecipeAuthoringGate(item) verdict is byte-identical (toEqual) to a direct Core validateAgainst([item], {stage:'all', path:'in-process', profile, sourceRefResolver: createInProcessSourceRefResolver(), projectRoot, dimensionId}) — proving the in-process WRAPPER faithfully passes through the same Core bar without mutating the verdict. Three cases: (1) opportunistic per-item over the full corpus, non-vacuous (≥1 clean item AND ≥1 with violations); (2) anti-trivial — the wrapper SELECTS opportunistic for a dimensionless submission and is NOT equal to the cold-start verdict (cold-start adds the 3-file floor on a single-file rule); (3) cold-start (dimension-bearing) wrapper == direct Core cold-start, proving the profile-resolution branch also doesn't mutate.

TRANSITIVE CLOSURE of host-vs-in-process tie: P1.4b already proved Core(path:host-cold-start) == Core(path:in-process) (path-label invariance); P4 proves in-process-wrapper == Core(path:in-process); the Plugin sibling (p4-plugin-drift-parity) proves host-wrapper == Core(host path). ⇒ host-wrapper == in-process-wrapper transitively (both equal the same Core validateAgainst).

git status proof: ONLY test/recipe-authoring-inprocess-parity.test.ts added; git diff --stat on recipeAuthoringGate.ts + knowledge.ts + insightProducer.ts + recipe-authoring-inprocess-flatten.test.ts = empty (wrapper + gates byte-unchanged)

risks: Additive test only (verified): git status shows ONLY the new test file; recipeAuthoringGate.ts wrapper + all gate paths byte-unchanged. No gate relaxed.

Parity passes by construction today: runInProcessRecipeAuthoringGate is a thin pass-through (resolveAuthoringProfile + validateAgainst, result returned unmutated); the test makes that contract EXPLICIT so any future wrapper-side mutation or profile-misresolution fails loudly. Per the task, on a future mismatch the discipline is to make the wrapper call the unified Core validateAgainst, NEVER to relax the gate.

The wrapper is single-item (validateAgainst([item])); the test compares per-item (itemIndex 0 on both sides), the faithful comparison for a single-item wrapper. A corpus-level validateAgainst would assign ascending itemIndex and is intentionally NOT the comparison target.

Cross-repo host-vs-in-process byte-identity is closed TRANSITIVELY (in-process-wrapper == Core == host-wrapper via the Plugin sibling p4-plugin-drift-parity), not by one in-repo test importing both wrappers (AlembicAgent cannot import AlembicPlugin internals). The Core §12.5 path-parity (tr-p4-core-drift-parity) + this in-process tie + the Plugin host tie are the three legs.
Consumes Core 47391c6 dist (fresh, verified). P4 wave 1 (Core) was additive-test-only so validateAgainst behavior is unchanged from the P1.4a profile model; the wrapper's consumption is stable.
